title: Exception triage
description: Every order checked across the four systems: the exceptions found, what to do about each, and the totals per kind.

summary.description: Two or three plain sentences with the counts and peso totals.

exceptions.description: One per order with a break, in kind order then longest outstanding first.

order_id.description: The order's id, the same in every system.

customer_email.description: From the ledger customer record. Null when it has none.

invoice_number.description: The ledger invoice number. Null when the order is not invoiced.

amount_minor.description: The amount at stake in centavos: the open balance, or the paid total for an order not shipped.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code in upper case, such as PHP.

reference_date.description: The invoice date, or the order date for an order not shipped, as YYYY-MM-DD (the date only, no time).

due_date.description: Invoice date plus the customer's payment terms, as YYYY-MM-DD (the date only, no time). Null for an order not shipped.

delivered_on.description: The day the warehouse delivered the order, as YYYY-MM-DD (the date only, no time). Null when it has not.

days_outstanding.description: Days from the reference date to the last day checked.

account_manager.description: The ledger's account manager, else the sales app seller, else null.

account_manager_email.description: The ledger's, else the sales app seller's, else the store's seller email, else null.

evidence.description: One sentence naming the business app's sections that disagree and what each shows.

clean_count.description: Orders that agree across every system.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code in upper case, such as PHP.

sign_off_note.description: One sentence naming each shipped-but-not-paid balance above ₱20,000 that needs finance's sign-off before its reminder, with its amount; empty when there is none.
